checks.name: action EVs for every legal action (sampled, eight seats)

detail.policyNote: Every seat (including the actor after this decision, and every seat's earlier actions that define the opponent ranges) follows the stored AVERAGE strategy.

utility.convention: ev = net chips of the acting seat relative to the study root (chips collected from main and side pots minus chips it puts in from the study root on, plus its own ante in preflop studies); identical for every action at this node. fromDecision = ev + chips the seat had already committed at this decision (sunk), i.e. chips collected minus ADDITIONAL chips put in from this decision on.
